items.prompt:
Read.

First the seed sprouts. Next roots grow. Then a stem rises.

The structure is:
A) chronological (time order)
B) compare and contrast
C) problem and solution

Which signal words show CAUSE and EFFECT?
A) first, next
B) because, so
C) alike, but

A text comparing cats and dogs uses which structure?
A) compare and contrast
B) sequence
C) cause and effect

Read.

Fish were dying in the lake. The town stopped dumping waste, and the fish returned.

The structure is:
A) problem and solution
B) compare and contrast
C) description

steps: Problem then fix. Key is A.

A) sequence

Read.

Cities and the countryside both have good points, but cities are busier while the countryside is quieter.

A) problem and solution
B) compare and contrast
